original.statement: Traefik now supports SNI routing with Postgres STARTTLS connections.

decision.reason: [ev-6c51e98dbb14] is a v3.0.0 Enhancements entry that says Traefik now supports SNI routing with Postgres STARTTLS connections. That is a new protocol capability, so the protocol-behavior family and the "added" change type fit. The name "postgres-starttls-sni-routing" is lowercase kebab-case built only from the evidence's own key words. The validators were inconclusive, so they neither support nor contradict this.
